subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose update execution over a gateway-authenticated HTTP surface for fleet tools, and if so should it be a dedicated `/admin/update` contract or an allowlisted Admin HTTP RPC wrapper around `update.run`?
rationale: The requested HTTP update path crosses from operator API access into host package replacement and restart authority, while current code intentionally keeps `update.run` off the Admin HTTP RPC allowlist.

options.title: Split and defer HTTP update authority
options.body: Keep the version metadata decision in the narrower tracker and require maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

options.title: Expose through Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Allow or wrap `update.run` only with explicit private-ingress, auth, audit, rate-limit, target-version, failure-mode, and upgrade-proof requirements.

options.title: Reject HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution limited to existing CLI/WebSocket/control-plane surfaces and document that fleet tools should use those or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Split and defer HTTP update authority
recommendation.body: Keep the version metadata decision in the narrower tracker and require maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across Admin HTTP RPC, runtime version helpers, and update/gateway security-sensitive surfaces.
